claims_and_decisions.claim: Two latent worlds yield identical all-zero/all-one repeated detection histories for all k under persistent detection availability
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Closed-form identical probabilities; not true for models with independent measurement resets.

claims_and_decisions.claim: Exact committed R115 Python executed with SHA match, all 2046 binary paths k1..10 pass
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Git SHA 63804ac702ad74e930ad797ccd40e0d06476902c; code tests exact math only.

claims_and_decisions.claim: Every 4.97 NAAMP frog visit history is constant (no within-site status changes)
claims_and_decisions.limitation: 2001 field source reports 4 negative→positive for each frog and 76/40 positive→negative transitions.

claims_and_decisions.claim: R115 extreme persistent detection mechanisms can serve as complete 4.97 frog data-generating models
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Both predict no within-site mixed statuses, whereas actual NAAMP source reports mixed records. Does not refute general occupancy modeling.

claims_and_decisions.claim: The observed NAAMP status changes prove biological extinction or colonization between visits
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Calling phenology/detectability/protocol/source distinctions remain plausible; NAAMP protocol-specific call index.

claims_and_decisions.claim: An exogenous independent detection-regime intervention could discriminate the two R115 worlds under fixed occupancy
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Toy calculation predicts nonzero 01 pair probability only in persistent availability world; actual physical reset not implemented.

claims_and_decisions.claim: More visits alone always identify site-level occupancy and detection without independence/heterogeneity assumptions
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Counterexample has joint observational equivalence for every repeat count; existing literature warns against assumption violation.

claims_and_decisions.claim: Condition any Q2/Q7 identification claim on genuine independent change in measurement operation and negative controls
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Not just remeasure with same shared hidden filter; seek calibration/known perturbation.

claims_and_decisions.claim: Treat 4.97 real frog status changes as negative controls, not 4.95 Finnish Anemone independent validation
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Different sampling sources, physical organisms, countries, years; no same-target transport.

claims_and_decisions.claim: Keep Maxwell–Faraday Q3/Q4/Q7 archival proof as parallel research, limit new ecologic toy loops
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Portfolio governance, independent seven-question charter, not scientific proof.

claims_and_decisions.claim: Promote MQR 5.5 from R115 symbolic PASS and old 4.97 field transitions
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Existing occupancy literature subsumes this idea and no independent incremental world-facing test has succeeded.

source_lineage: Seven scored source records; seven cautious roots, but independent field roots only NAAMP 2001 and GBIF 2024. R115 code is mathematical and cannot count as a third field source.
metric_semantics: E/C/G/L are declared bounded judgment scores, not experimentally calibrated probabilities.
